patthana15.32:1.1: noāsavaṃ kusalaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na noāsavo na kusalo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā: ekaṃ.
patthana15.32:2.1: āsavaṃ akusalaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca no āsavo na akusalo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā: tīṇi.
patthana15.32:3.1: noāsavaṃ abyākataṃ dhammaṃ paccayā na noāsavo na abyākato dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā: tīṇi. sāsavaduka kusalattike nasāsavaduka nakusalattikaṃ
